packet_conflict_resolution.rationale: The canonical formula is the current exact-GTIN 4895248005872 retailer label transcription. The global Being manufacturer page publishes a materially different market/formula variant; it remains explicit conflict evidence and is not merged. The common early cleansing architecture is visible, but later-order and disclosure differences remain for the classification lanes to assess.

current_sources.label: Hagel Shop DE exact GTIN PDP

explicit_conflicts.description: The global Being manufacturer page lists a different ordered formula from the exact-GTIN retail label sources. Its version has Polyquaternium-10 earlier, includes Linoleamidopropyl PG-Dimonium Chloride Phosphate and Tocopheryl Acetate, and orders late ingredients differently; the exact-GTIN retail formula discloses Sodium Citrate and Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes. No formula merge is permitted.

The German Rossmann source uses Big Hair Shampoo, while English retailer and global manufacturer sources use BIG HAIR Volumizing/Big Volume Thickening Shampoo. The GTIN and 354 ml pack bind the exact German SKU identity; translated marketing wording is not used as an alias formula match.
